rows.note: Motor vehicle technician (Kraftfahrzeugtechniker) is a trade in Anlage A of the Handwerksordnung: the business must be in the Handwerksrolle of its Handwerkskammer, with a Meister or an equivalent. Each chamber keeps its own register.
Electrician (Elektrotechniker) is a trade in Anlage A of the Handwerksordnung: the business must be in the Handwerksrolle of its Handwerkskammer, with a Meister or an equivalent.
Plumbing and heating (Installateur und Heizungsbauer) is a trade in Anlage A of the Handwerksordnung: the business must be in the Handwerksrolle of its Handwerkskammer.
Hairdressing (Friseure) is a trade in Anlage A of the Handwerksordnung: the business must be in the Handwerksrolle of its Handwerkskammer.
Bespoke tailoring (Maßschneider) is in Anlage B of the Handwerksordnung: anyone may run it, with no Meister needed. It is listed with the chamber, which is not a licence.
